## Before you open this PR

This repository holds documentation, issue templates, and release
artifacts for Arc Flow — **it does not contain the application's source
code**, which is maintained in a private repository. Pull requests here can
only address things that actually live in this repo: typos or unclear
wording in the docs, improvements to the issue/PR templates, or fixes to
files like `CHANGELOG.md` and `SECURITY.md`.

If your change is about the application itself (a bug fix, a new feature,
etc.), please open an [issue](../../issues/new/choose) describing it
instead — it can't be merged as a PR here.
